name: TikTok for Business
description: TikTok for Business MCP Server is a standardized bridge built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that enables developers and advertisers to connect Claude directly to the TikTok Ads platform. By exposing core advertising functions — campaign management, performance reporting, audience configuration, and creative operations — as a set of reliable, production-ready tools, the MCP Server allows AI agents to manage, optimize, and report on TikTok advertising through simple, structured instructions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TikTok for Business to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TikTok for Business to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer-anthropic. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TikTok for Business MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TikTok for Business lists 39 MCP tools, including advertiser_info_get, app_info_get, app_list_get, app_optimization_event_get, auth_advertiser_get, bc_get, catalog_feed_get, catalog_get, catalog_overview_get, catalog_product_get, catalog_set_get, and catalog_video_package_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TikTok for Business?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to TikTok for Business in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does TikTok for Business MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: TikTok for Business requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TikTok for Business is developed by TikTok. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
